text:
alice (ops): Observed spike in 502/504 and GPU allocation errors in eu-west3 starting ~1769854300. NetGW flapping reported by cloud provider. KMS calls failing intermittently 500s.
carla (sre): Seeing queue backlog on worker pools, autoscaler not spinning because K8s nodes failing joining due to network mounts failing.
alice (ops): impact: hosted inference latency + errors for some dedicated customers in EU. non-critical batch jobs also stuck. raising incident.
ben (platform): Noted increased cross-region egress if we failover — cost estimate ~+$6k/day if we shift steady traffic to us-central.
dave (eng-infra): Stacktrace from agent:
```
2026-03-05T14:12:01Z allocate_gpu: allocation failed: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = dial tcp: connect: connect: network is unreachable
KMS Encrypt: 500 InternalServerError
```
carla (sre): infra-bot reports provider status: 'Networking degradation affecting load balancers and NAT gateways in eu-west3' (public bulletin)
alice (ops): immediate mitigation ideas: 1) route traffic to eu-west1/uk region via L7 rules 2) allow fallback to local AES envelope keys for auth tokens 3) throttle non-urgent batch inference
eva (support): Customers reporting errors: cust-acme and cust-slate complaining about timeouts on hosted endpoints.
ben (platform): We need emergency customer communication. I'll draft a notice. Also ask sales to check dedicated contracts — some have geo restrictions.
dave (eng-infra): Technical plan: 1) temporarily enable cross-region routing: add eu-west1 as fallback in SmartRouter policy and tag eu-west1 model variants as fallback-compatible. 2) Deploy KMS proxy that retries and falls back to cached DEKs for 10m. 3) Pause autoscale down to avoid churn.
carla (sre): Rolling the KMS proxy now to canary pool. Will monitor cache hit rate. :spinner:
infra-bot: Deployed kms-proxy v1.3 to canary (3 pods) at 1769854358
alice (ops): Can we throttle non-essential internal jobs? dave?
dave (eng-infra): Kicking a maintenance window script to mark non-critical batch nodes with taint: no-inference. Will reduce contention.
ben (platform): Approved emergency egress spend up to $10k/day by finance — set budget tag 'incident-1769854321'
eva (support): Sent initial message to affected customers: holding pattern + ETA 2h. Will update once traffic shift completes.
carla (sre): Canary KMS proxy succeeded for 2/3 attempts then fell back to DEK cache. No token failures on canary.
alice (ops): Starting routing change now via SmartRouter policy. Expect 5-10% error rate during warmup. Monitoring dashboards live.
infra-bot: SmartRouter policy updated: add eu-west1 fallback, active routes: eu-west3(80%), eu-west1(20%) at 1769854372
carla (sre): Error rate down to 3% and latency stabilizing. GPU allocation errors decreased. Continuing to observe.
dave (eng-infra): Reminder: document workaround for Private customers — if KMS locked, instruct them to rotate to customer-managed key or use on-prem HSM as permitted.
alice (ops): Postmortem action items: 1) add regional KMS failover in control plane 2) improve autoscaler resilience to transient network errors 3) cost playbook for cross-region failover
ben (platform): Good job. Will coordinate customer comms for final remediation and billing reprieve.
eva (support): Updating thread: customers ack'd that responses are back, closing alerts as we confirm 30m stable.
carla (sre): Marking incident resolved pending postmortem. :white_check_mark:
